title: CBDC Ban Has a 2030 Expiration Date
script_summary:
**Senate just handed Bitcoin a 2030 deadline — and the market's pricing it in.**

Eighty-nine to ten vote to ban CBDCs sounds clean. It's not. Buried in the text: a sunset clause that reopens the surveillance window in 2030. DC just told you when the real fight starts.

Meanwhile, three pressure systems are converging. Rate cut odds jumped from nine percent to thirty-five percent in three weeks — that means tighter money for longer. Arthur Hayes is positioning pure hard assets: Bitcoin and gold.
